summary.answer: Builds the ultimate/ability meter and PC/gamepad activation strings. Stored visibility/input/ability-state predicates include explicit AlwaysFalse cases. Child model/image/power callbacks and LastInput/state validation are separate. After close registration the optional PreLoadFunc runs; on PC the gamepad HeroAbilityHoldString is hidden. Creates self via LUI.UIElement.new, Blur via LUI.UIImage.new, BlurRight via LUI.UIImage.new, BlurLeft via LUI.UIImage.new, PanelRight via LUI.UIImage.new, PanelLeft via LUI.UIImage.new, Panel via LUI.UIImage.new, ControllerDependentTextBox via CoD.ControllerDependent_TextBox.new, TankUseString via CoD.AmmoWidget_AbilityText.new, Frame via LUI.UIImage.new, GlowHero via LUI.UIImage.new, LED via LUI.UIImage.new, FullBackingDeployed via LUI.UIImage.new, AbilityPulse via CoD.AmmoWidgetMP_Ability_Flash.new, AmmoWidgetAbilityContainer via CoD.AmmoWidget_AbilityContainer.new, UltimateRadialMeterpath2 via LUI.UIImage.new, PowerBasedImageAvailable via LUI.UIImage.new, PowerBasedImageUnavailable via LUI.UIImage.new, combatEfficiencyActive via LUI.UIImage.new, UltimateRadialMeterWipes via CoD.AmmoWidgetMP_Ultimate_Progress_Fill.new, HeroAbilityHoldString via CoD.AbilityHoldToActivate.new, HeroAbilityHoldStringPC via CoD.AbilityHoldToActivate.new, GlowRing via LUI.UIImage.new, FlareBack via LUI.UIImage.new, NotAvailable via CoD.AmmoWidget_HeroEmpty.new. Stores state predicates Hidden, KeyboardAndMouse, KeyboardAndMouseAbility, KeyboardAndMouseUltimate, KeyboardAndMouseScoreStreak, TankInbound, TankReadyForCommands, TankEntered, HideThroughParentAlpha, Restricted, InUse, Deployed, PowerBasedEmptyCharging_CombatEfficiency, PowerBasedEmptyCharging, PowerBasedCharging_CombatEfficiency, PowerBasedCharging, PowerBased; their body effects require state-system evaluation.
